high.title: SACOMBANK Sets Record: From the "Golden Touch" of Mr. Nguyen Duc Thuy to Brand Name Change with "Feng Shui" Elements
high.summary: SACOMBANK (STB) shareholders are experiencing a golden period as the stock continuously breaks through to new peaks. The bank's market capitalization has set a record of nearly 145,000 billion VND, up 32% since the beginning of 2026. This follows the surprising appearance of Mr. Nguyen Duc Thuy as Acting CEO at the end of last year. The Ninh Binh-born businessman is famous for his "golden touch" in the stock market according to the head of the billion-dollar foreign fund Pyn Elite Fund, who stated that "Mr. Thuy has an excellent reputation as the founder of LPBank, and Vietnamese retail investors believe everything he touches turns to gold." Since Mr. Thuy's arrival at SACOMBANK, the bank has changed its brand identity, streamlined operations, and appointed new personnel. This banking sector development is significant for VN-Index performance as SACOMBANK is a major constituent.

high.title: Another Securities Company Lowers VN-Index Forecast for 2026
high.summary: VNDirect Research has revised down its VN-Index target for 2026, now forecasting the index to close at 1,967 points, representing a 10.2% gain versus 2025. This is lower than the initial 2,100-point target set at the beginning of the year, reflecting external uncertainties that could cause short-term market volatility. Despite the revision, VNDirect maintains that stable macroeconomic fundamentals, positive earnings growth prospects, and relatively attractive valuations support continued upward momentum for VN-Index in 2026. The research house projects 14% earnings growth for HSX-listed companies in 2026. This forecast adjustment is crucial for FX and equity market expectations, particularly as Vietnam approaches the FTSE Russell secondary emerging market upgrade in September 2026.

high.title: VN-Index Approaches Historical Peak, Securities Firm Warns of "Green Outside, Red Inside" Scenario
high.summary: After strong market recovery in April 2026, VN-Index is approaching strong resistance around the historical peak of 1,910 (+/- 30 points). VNDirect warns that despite impressive point gains, money flow indicators show lack of consensus as liquidity hasn't shown signs of breakthrough. Market breadth remains unconvincing as VN-Index gains are concentrated in a few large-cap stocks. The index's trailing P/E has decreased to 13.8x, below the 10-year average of 15.4x thanks to positive earnings growth in Q1/2026. While not yet in "cheap" territory, current valuations are supported by market upgrade expectations and sustained positive earnings growth prospects. This technical analysis is critical for understanding potential VN-Index direction and its impact on VND sentiment and foreign capital flows.

medium.title: Vietnam Will Soon Have Another Bank Reaching 3 Million Billion VND in Assets, SHB and HDBank Preparing to Touch New Milestone
medium.summary: BIDV continues as the largest bank with over 3,388 trillion VND in assets, up 1.7% from end-2025. VietinBank is becoming the next candidate to join the "3 trillion club" with assets reaching over 2,924 trillion VND, up 5.6% in Q1/2026 alone, requiring only 76,000 billion VND more to reach the milestone.

medium.title: Bank Revenue Race: BIDV Loses Throne, VPBank Rises to Match Big4 Group
medium.summary: Total operating income for 27 listed banks reached 190,371 billion VND in Q1/2026, up 15% year-on-year. However, significant changes occurred in revenue rankings among banks, with traditional leaders facing new competition from rising private banks.

medium.title: One Bank's Assets Decrease by Over 57,000 Billion VND
medium.summary: Sacombank's total assets fell to 859,572 billion VND at end-Q1/2026, down 57,548 billion VND (6.3%) from end-2025. The decline was mainly due to reduced interbank deposits, falling from 171,012 billion VND to 113,369 billion VND, indicating potential liquidity management adjustments.

medium.title: Large Money Becomes Selective, Expert Names High-Ranking Stock Groups in the Market
medium.summary: ABS's investment banking director notes Asian stock indices continue leading in growth, while emerging markets maintain 88-point growth ranking. Vietnam's VN-Index improved from 80 to 84 points after setting new historical highs, reflecting sustained upward momentum.

medium.title: Securities Company Worth Thousands of Billions Gets Heavy Fine
medium.summary: Bao Minh Securities (BMS) was fined 187.5 million VND for failing to maintain proper separation of customer assets from company assets, and an additional 92.5 million VND for failing to disclose required information about transactions valued at 10% or more of total assets.

medium.title: Afternoon 13/5: Gold Bar and Gold Ring Prices Both Decline
medium.summary: Gold prices dropped across major dealers, with gold bars and rings falling 500,000 VND per tael to 162.0-165.0 million VND/tael range. International gold spot prices hovered around $4,700/ounce, down about $20/ounce from morning levels.
